gloss: worth listening to; engaging to hear

definitions.gloss: worth listening to; engaging to hear
definitions.explanation: Said of a story, speech, music, or interview that has enough substance, skill, or depth to reward the listener. The opposite of dull or shallow.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{話|はなし}は{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えがある。
examples.english: His stories are worth listening to.

examples.japanese: {聞|き}き{応|ごた}えのある{講演|こうえん}だった。
examples.english: It was a lecture worth listening to.

examples.japanese: ベテラン{歌手|かしゅ}の{歌唱力|かしょうりょく}はやはり{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えがある。
examples.english: As expected, the vocal skill of a veteran singer is engaging to hear.

notes:
Compound of {聞|き}く (to listen) + {応|ごた}え (response, effect) + がある (there is). The 〜{応|ごた}えがある pattern is productive: {食|た}べ{応|ごた}えがある (filling), {読|よ}み{応|ごた}えがある (worth reading), {見|み}{応|ごた}えがある (worth watching).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {聞|き}き{応|ごた}えのある{話|はなし}: a story worth hearing
- {聞|き}き{応|ごた}えのある{演奏|えんそう}: a performance worth listening to
- {実|じつ}に{聞|き}き{応|ごた}えがある: truly worth listening to

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {興味深|きょうみぶか}い: interesting — intellectual interest, doesn't imply substance
- {面白|おもしろ}い: interesting, fun — broader and more casual
- {見|み}{応|ごた}えがある: worth watching — the visual counterpart
